blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Already out of contention, ZUS Coffee remained eager to finish strong, taking down Akari, 25-22, 22-25, 25-18, 25-21, in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Philsports Arena. AC Miner led the Thunderbelles to their second consecutive victory with 16 points off 15 kills and one kill, returning to her original middle blocker since the last match. Zam Nolasco also dominated the frontline with 12 points, all from attacks out of her 25 spike attempts, while Chinnie Arroyo had 11 points.
